content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm also experiencing issues when trying to set up the initial connection to the [product_name]. I've reviewed the previously mentioned advice, but haven't managed to get it working. Currently, I can't ping the device, which seems unusual. Additionally, I noticed that in the PC's network settings, the area where you set how the IP address is obtained is not editable—the selection for specifying an IP address is checked, but it doesn't match the PC's actual address. Could that be causing the problem? Thanks. [user_name]

The reason the PC's network settings appear grayed out in the network view is because they are meant for information only and cannot be modified there. Instead, open a Windows command prompt and enter 'ipconfig /all' to display all relevant network data for your PC. Please take a screenshot and share it with us.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is struggling to establish an initial network connection to the [product_name]. Main challenges include the inability to ping the device and confusion over non-editable network configuration options on the PC. There is uncertainty regarding whether incorrect PC IP settings are responsible for connection issues, highlighting the need for more intuitive network setup processes and clearer system feedback.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a simple way to adjust the PC’s network configuration and to connect to the [product_name] without complications. They also hope for clearer, step-by-step troubleshooting guidance when network connection problems arise.
